newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Doctors, nurses go on strike in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Doctors, nurses go on strike in Cyprus.

text.p: Hundreds of doctors and nurses staged a four-hour strike at government hospitals in Cyprus on Monday demanding better work conditions.
About 450 doctors employed in the civil service observed the stoppage which started at 10.00 a.m. local time (0800 GMT) until noon.
They are seeking full pensions after 27 years of service and an upgrade of pay scales for general practitioners.
"These are requests for discussions which were put in years ago and are still pending," the head of the doctors union Demetris Demetriou said.
"We decided to put a bit of pressure on them (the health ministry) hoping they come to their senses," he told Reuters.
Routine operations were put on hold on Monday. The work stoppage did not cover emergency cases, Demetriou said.
Nursing staff at hospitals in the coastal towns of Limassol and Paphos also stopped work for two hours on Monday to protest at poor staffing levels.
